# Proverbs 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Does-not Wisdom call, and-Understanding give her-voice?

**2** At-[the]-top-of [the]-heights beside [the]-way, at-[the]-house-of [the]-paths she-stands.

**3** Beside [the]-gates, at-[the]-mouth-of [the]-city, at-[the]-entrance-of [the]-openings she-cries-out:

**4** "To-you, O-men, I-call, and-my-voice [is] to [the]-sons-of mankind.

**5** Understand, simple-ones, prudence; and-fools, understand heart.

**6** Hear, for noble-things I-speak, and-[the]-opening-of my-lips [is] upright-things.

**7** For truth my-palate utters, and-an-abomination to-my-lips [is] wickedness.

**8** In-righteousness [are] all [the]-words-of my-mouth; there-is-not in-them [anything]-twisted or-crooked.

**9** All-of-them [are] straight to-the-one-understanding, and-right to-those-finding knowledge.

**10** Receive my-discipline and-not silver, and-knowledge rather-than choice gold.

**11** For better [is] wisdom than-corals, and-all delights cannot-equal-her.

**12** I, Wisdom, dwell [with] prudence, and-knowledge-of discretions I-find.

**13** Fear-of YHWH [is to]-hate evil; pride and-arrogance and-[the]-way-of evil and-[the]-mouth-of perversities I-hate.

**14** To-me [are] counsel and-sound-wisdom; I [am] understanding; to-me [is] strength.

**15** By-me kings reign, and-rulers decree righteousness.

**16** By-me princes rule, and-nobles — all judges-of [the]-earth.

**17** I love those-loving-me, and-those-seeking-me-earnestly will-find-me.

**18** Riches and-honor [are] with-me, enduring wealth and-righteousness.

**19** Better [is] my-fruit than-gold and-than-fine-gold, and-my-yield than-choice silver.

**20** In-[the]-path-of righteousness I-walk, in-[the]-midst-of [the]-paths-of justice,

**21** To-cause-to-inherit those-loving-me substance, and-their-treasuries I-fill.

**22** YHWH acquired-me [at the]-beginning-of His-way, before His-works from-then.

**23** From-eternity I-was-set-up, from-[the]-beginning, from-[the]-precedences-of [the]-earth.

**24** When-there-were-no deeps I-was-brought-forth, when-there-were-no springs abounding-[with] water.

**25** Before mountains were-sunk, before hills I-was-brought-forth,

**26** While-not-yet He-had-made [the]-earth and-[the]-open-fields, and-[the]-first-of [the]-dusts-of [the]-world.

**27** When-He-established [the]-heavens, there I [was]; when-He-inscribed a-circle upon [the]-face-of [the]-deep,

**28** When-He-made-firm [the]-skies above, when-He-strengthened [the]-springs-of [the]-deep,

**29** When-He-set for-the-sea its-boundary, and-[the]-waters would-not-transgress His-command, when-He-marked-out [the]-foundations-of [the]-earth —

**30** And-I-was beside-Him [as] a-master-worker, and-I-was delights day [by] day, playing before-Him at-all-times,

**31** Playing in-[the]-world-of His-earth, and-my-delights [were] with-[the]-sons-of mankind.

**32** And-now, sons, hear to-me, and-blessed [are those who]-keep my-ways.

**33** Hear discipline and-be-wise, and-do-not-neglect [it].

**34** Blessed [is the]-man [who]-listens to-me, watching at-my-doors day [by] day, guarding [the]-doorposts-of my-entrances.

**35** For [the one]-finding-me finds life, and-obtains favor from-YHWH.

**36** But-[the one]-sinning-against-me wrongs his-[own]-soul; all [those]-hating-me love death."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **8:22**: Qanani — YHWH 'acquired/possessed/created me.' The verb qanah is debated: 'created' (LXX ektise), 'possessed,' 'acquired,' or 'begot.' Central to 4th-century Christological debates.

- **8:30**: Amon — 'master worker' or 'nursling/child.' The vocalization determines meaning. If amon: craftsman at God's side. If amun: child/nursling being nurtured.

- **8:22-31**: Wisdom's pre-existence poem — the most theologically significant passage in Proverbs. Wisdom was present at creation, either as agent or witness.

— EMET
